statusDefinitions.DONE: Entire requirement and its acceptance evidence complete. No row is promoted solely because code exists.
statusDefinitions.PARTIAL: Source work supplied; acceptance, owner configuration, build or review evidence remains.
statusDefinitions.GAP: Required external/public delivery has not occurred.
statusDefinitions.development: DONE means the in-scope source deliverable is supplied, not that its live acceptance passed; EXCLUDED identifies required external/public actions.

catalogueScope: Implementation and delivery tracking. Status is not a test result or regulatory certificate; executed results are in release/validation.json and ci-evidence.json.
